summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Ishaq Material culture/106)

data.turoyo: <...> Bi+ḥarayṭo, xud u+qtoro dab+bote dməḷḷan, u+quflo ḥaroyo briše, lalʕəl bqarʕe, məsxərwa u+gdišo, aš+šʕore kulle fayšiwa laltaḥ. Hánoste gdišoyo. <...>
data.translation: <...> Finally, like the roof of the houses that we discussed, the last sheaf on its top, upwards on its head, the bushel would be closed, all the barley would stay downwards (i.e., on the inside). So this is a bushel.

rationale: First Detransitive Infectum-wa box; capping a grain stack.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC NE Farrucke/10)

data.turoyo: Mədla li+ṣalk̇e, azzá. Ánnaqqa u+tarʕo di+ṣàlkeste… di+bàxčaste, ǝmmiwa, ‘Šaltaḥ maltaḥ, qarʕax laltaḥ, raġloṯax lalʕal’, məsxarwa. Dəmmiwa, ‘Šaltaḥ maltaḥ’, xayo, ‘raġlax laltaḥ ŭ raġloṯux lalʕal’, məftaḥwa.
data.translation: She took the basket, she went. Now then, the door of the basket… of the garden, they would say, ‘Groundwards downwards, your head down, your feet up’, it would get closed. If they said, ‘Groundwards downwards’, like that one, ‘your foot (i.e., feet) down and your feet (i.e., head) up’, it would get opened.

rationale: Independent Detransitive Infectum-wa example; habitual magical door closure, paired with opening.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (PrS 64/70)

data.turoyo: Omər: "Əno gdəmannəx xabro." Əmmo: "Mar." Omər: "Lə qqudrət ʕal i walaye, kit bu diyar šaṭ d maye rabo, kle qm u šaṭ sxiro b qiro w zafto, ftaḥe, arfaye ʕal i walaye, gmahəzmi, ghozət gawrəx w abnəx."
data.translation: Da sprach der Fuchs: "ich will dir ein Wort sagen." "Sprich!" "Gegen die Stadt hast du keine Macht", hob er an, "aber auf dem Berge ist ein grosser Fluss, welcher mit Pech und Harz wohl eingedämmt ist; mache dem Wasser eine Oeffnung und lass es gegen die Stadt los, dann werden sie die Flucht ergreifen, und du wirst deinen Mann und deine Söhne sehen."

rationale: Thin Part. Pass. cell; river barrier with material b-.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Lahdo Traitor 1/80)

data.turoyo: Ono məlli omanno: "Ṭro quṭlili, lanno ṭaw manək, d qṭili. Ṭro ṣuxri i ʕito. Haka ʕal foṯi d məṣxoro i ʕito, ṭro ṣuxrila. Ma i ʕito layba... qay ma hno yo gṣuxri i ʕito. E, hawxa yaʕni, hawxa yo."
data.translation: I answered and said: let them then kill me! Iam in no way better than all those that were massacred! Let them close down the church! If the church will be closed down because of me, let them then kill ... close it down! The church cannot ... it won’t be that easy to close down the church. So, this is it, this is how it is.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Infectum cell; institutional church closure, with agent absent.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (88/231)

data.turoyo: “Aydarbo ṣəxrina u=tarʕo?” Omər: “Ono hawxa, i=qəṣṣayḏi, d lo=məṣxər u=tarʕo w u=qliḏo howe b kisti, lo=kqodanno d omanno i=qəṣṣayḏi.”
data.translation: Wie sollen wir denn die Tür verschließen?" Es sprach: "Bei mir ist es nun einmal so. Wenn die Tür nicht verschlossen wird und der Schlüssel in meiner Tasche ist, kann ich meine Geschichte nicht erzählen."

rationale: Thin Detransitive Infectum cell; conditional closed door and emphatic spelling.

data.translation: So I stopped. The readers were very upset. Even now people make telephone calls; they say: ‘We are subscribing…’ After six months. I tell them: ‘It is closed!’

The finite Detransitive forms sxir/ṣxir and participial sxiro/sxire distinguish event or result-state predication from expanded state forms. Snow gives an inanimate cause with m-, not a human agent.
